messages.content: Turn off the living room lights and check if the front door is locked.

messages.name: set_device_state
messages.content: {"status": "success", "device": "lights", "state": "off"}
I have turned off the living room lights. Let me check the front door lock now.

messages.name: get_device_status
messages.content: {"status": "unlocked"}
The front door is currently unlocked. Would you like me to lock it for you?
Yes, lock it and arm the security system to stay mode.

messages.name: set_device_state
messages.content: {"status": "success"}

messages.name: set_security_mode
messages.content: {"status": "armed_stay"}
The front door is locked and the security system is now armed in stay mode.
Set the kitchen thermostat to 22 degrees.

messages.name: set_climate
messages.content: {"status": "success", "current_temp": 24, "target_temp": 22}
I have set the kitchen thermostat to 22 degrees. It is currently 24 degrees and cooling down.
Actually, make it 20 degrees instead and turn on the kitchen ceiling fan.

messages.name: set_climate
messages.content: {"status": "success", "target_temp": 20}

messages.name: set_device_state
messages.content: {"status": "success", "state": "on"}
Updated. The kitchen thermostat is now set to 20 degrees, and the ceiling fan is running.
Is the garage door open right now?

messages.name: get_device_status
messages.content: {"status": "open"}
Yes, the garage door is currently open.
Close it and turn on the garage security camera.

messages.name: set_device_state
messages.content: {"status": "success", "state": "closed"}

messages.name: set_device_state
messages.content: {"status": "success", "state": "on"}
I have successfully closed the garage door and activated the garage security camera.
I am leaving for work now.

messages.name: set_security_mode
messages.content: {"status": "armed_away"}
The system is armed to away mode. Should I turn off all the indoor smart plugs to save electricity?
Yes please, except for the living room router plug.

messages.name: bulk_control_plugs
messages.content: {"status": "success", "turned_off_count": 5}
All smart plugs have been powered down, leaving your living room router online. Have a great day at work!
Dim the bedroom lights to 30% and play some relaxing music.

messages.name: set_light_brightness
messages.content: {"status": "success", "brightness": 30}

messages.name: play_media
messages.content: {"status": "playing", "playlist": "Deep Relaxation"}
I have set the bedroom lights to 30% and started playing the 'Deep Relaxation' playlist.
Set a sleep timer on the music for 45 minutes.

messages.name: set_media_timer
messages.content: {"status": "timer_set", "duration": 45}
Your bedroom music will automatically turn off in 45 minutes.
Is the washing machine done?

messages.name: get_device_status
messages.content: {"status": "running", "time_remaining_minutes": 12}
The washing machine is still running. There are 12 minutes remaining in the cycle.
Okay, broadcast a voice message saying 'Laundry is almost ready' to the living room speaker.

messages.name: broadcast_message
messages.content: {"status": "success"}
I have broadcasted the message to the living room speaker.
Start cleaning the hallway with the robot vacuum.

messages.name: control_vacuum
messages.content: {"status": "cleaning", "zone": "hallway"}
The robot vacuum has started cleaning the hallway.
Wait, the baby is sleeping. Stop it immediately and send it back to the dock.

messages.name: control_vacuum
messages.content: {"status": "returning_to_dock"}
I have stopped the cleaning cycle. The vacuum is now returning to its charging dock.
What is the current humidity level in the baby's room?

messages.name: get_sensor_data
messages.content: {"humidity_percentage": 31}
The current humidity level in the baby's room is quite low at 31%.
Please turn on the humidifier in there and set it to auto mode.

messages.name: set_device_state
messages.content: {"status": "success"}

messages.name: set_device_mode
messages.content: {"status": "success", "mode": "auto"}
I have turned on the humidifier in the baby's room and configured it to auto mode.
Turn on the backyard patio lights and set them to blue.

messages.name: set_device_state
messages.content: {"status": "success"}

messages.name: set_light_color
messages.content: {"status": "success", "color": "blue"}
The patio lights are now on and set to blue.
They look too bright. Bring the brightness down to 50%.

messages.name: set_light_brightness
messages.content: {"status": "success", "brightness": 50}
I have adjusted the backyard patio lights to 50% brightness.
Is the coffee maker on?

messages.name: get_device_status
messages.content: {"status": "off"}
No, the coffee maker is currently turned off.
Turn it on and start brewing an espresso.

messages.name: set_device_state
messages.content: {"status": "success"}

messages.name: brew_beverage
messages.content: {"status": "brewing", "beverage": "espresso"}
The coffee maker has been turned on and your espresso is now brewing.
